title.kn: ಬಾಕಿ ವೆಚ್ಚಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಮುಂಗಡ ಪಾವತಿಸಿದ ವೆಚ್ಚಗಳು

heading.en: Paid too little, paid too early

hook.en: The electricity bill for March arrives in April. The insurance premium paid in October covers part of next year. Both must be adjusted.

narration.kn: ಬಾಕಿ ವೆಚ್ಚ ಎಂದರೆ ಈ ವರ್ಷ ಆಗಿದ್ದು ಇನ್ನೂ ಪಾವತಿಸದ ವೆಚ್ಚ. ಅದನ್ನು ಸಂಬಂಧಿತ ವೆಚ್ಚಕ್ಕೆ ಸೇರಿಸಿ, ಆಢಾವೆ ಪತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ಚಾಲ್ತಿ ಹೊಣೆಗಾರಿಕೆಯಾಗಿ ತೋರಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: A prepaid expense has been paid in the current year for a benefit to be received next year. Entry: Prepaid Expense A/c Dr To Expense A/c. Treatment: deduct it from the expense in the profit and loss account, and show it as a current asset in the balance sheet.

narration.kn: ಮುಂಗಡ ವೆಚ್ಚ ಎಂದರೆ ಮುಂದಿನ ವರ್ಷದ ಸೌಲಭ್ಯಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ಈ ವರ್ಷವೇ ಪಾವತಿಸಿದ ವೆಚ್ಚ. ಅದನ್ನು ವೆಚ್ಚದಿಂದ ಕಳೆದು, ಆಢಾವೆ ಪತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ಚಾಲ್ತಿ ಆಸ್ತಿಯಾಗಿ ತೋರಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

problem.en: The trial balance of Sagar Enterprises on 31 March 2025 shows Salaries ₹55,000 (11 months) and Insurance ₹12,000 paid on 1 October 2024 for one year. Find the amounts for the profit and loss account and the balance sheet.

steps.en: Salaries in P&L = 55,000 + 5,000 = ₹60,000; outstanding salary ₹5,000 is a current liability.
Insurance covers October 2024 to September 2025: 6 months (April–September 2025) are prepaid = 12,000 × 6/12 = ₹6,000.
Insurance in P&L = 12,000 − 6,000 = ₹6,000; prepaid insurance ₹6,000 is a current asset.

narration.en: Let us work this out together. The trial balance of Sagar Enterprises on 31 March 2025 shows Salaries ₹55,000 (11 months) and Insurance ₹12,000 paid on 1 October 2024 for one year. Find the amounts for the profit and loss account and the balance sheet.

body.en: Outstanding expense: Add to the expense, show as a Liability (OAL). Prepaid expense: Deduct from the expense, show as an Asset (PDA). Incomes work the opposite way.

narration.en: Expenses: OAL and PDA. Outstanding expense: Add to the expense, show as a Liability (OAL). Prepaid expense: Deduct from the expense, show as an Asset (PDA). Incomes work the opposite way.

homework.en: Rent of ₹36,000 was paid for 15 months on 1 January 2025. Find the rent for the year ended 31 March 2025 and the prepaid amount.

narration.en: Recap. Outstanding expense: add to the expense; current liability. Prepaid expense: deduct from the expense; current asset. Count months carefully from the date of payment.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಬಾಕಿ ವೆಚ್ಚ: ವೆಚ್ಚಕ್ಕೆ ಸೇರಿಸಿ; ಚಾಲ್ತಿ ಹೊಣೆಗಾರಿಕೆ. ಮುಂಗಡ ವೆಚ್ಚ: ವೆಚ್ಚದಿಂದ ಕಳೆಯಿರಿ; ಚಾಲ್ತಿ ಆಸ್ತಿ. ಪಾವತಿ ದಿನಾಂಕದಿಂದ ತಿಂಗಳುಗಳನ್ನು ಎಚ್ಚರಿಕೆಯಿಂದ ಎಣಿಸಿ.
